1.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: full-page watercolor illustration for a children's Nuh story.
Input images: Image 1 is the edit target; preserve its scene, camera, portrait 2:3 aspect ratio, ark design where present, palette, fine watercolor paper texture and lighting. Change only by adding the explicitly requested small ordinary figures.
CRITICAL: Nuh/Noah and ALL prophets are completely absent. Do not depict a prophet in any form, including silhouette, back, body part or implied central leader. All people are anonymous ordinary villagers/believers of equal visual emphasis; no preacher, prayer leader, staff, halo, divine figure, idol or religious statue. No violence.
CRITICAL EYE RULE: Every human and every animal has absolutely NO drawn eyes: no pupils, dots, eye outlines, lashes, closed eyelid lines, sockets, or eye-shaped marks. Faces are naturally uninterrupted warm skin watercolor; animal faces are naturally uninterrupted fur watercolor. Do not cover eyes with patches, paint streaks, masks or blurring. Their simplified faces have never had eyes drawn. This must be consistent for every figure.
Keep sparse, tasteful, subordinate scale and wide breathing room; figures naturally integrated in existing watercolor, no modern items, no text, no letters, no watermark.

Primary request: Add exactly three small ordinary villagers in modest earth-tone ancient clothing, casually walking or talking on the existing lower village lane around y=70–87% of image height. No dominant person. All three full bodies, hands and heads remain entirely below y=60%. No animals. Preserve the top 40% quiet sky and all settlement architecture unchanged.
